instruction: Close the room door all the way. Then stand in the middle of the room, about 1.5–2 m from the door wall, facing it. Slowly sweep the phone from floor to ceiling across the strip of wall just beside the door: the part the open door was pressed against, roughly the first metre of that wall next to the door frame. Include the door frame edge too, and move slowly over it.
reason: Everything else in the scan is good. All 6 walls were measured directly (error 0.6–1.5 cm), the ceiling height is 2.60 m, and the door is 0.91 m wide and 2.09 m tall. The one real hole is on the door wall (w1): the open door leaf (o1) blocked about 0.72 m × 2.06 m of wall (1.43 m²) between 0.34 m and 1.06 m along w1. The scan can't tell what's there (for example a radiator, socket or shelf). It also doesn't show which side the door is hinged on, which matters for where furniture can go without blocking the door. There's also a thin weak strip at the door frame edge (1.18–1.22 m). Closing the door and rescanning that strip fixes all three issues.
